name: Green Mountain National Forest
story: Green Mountain National Forest is a national forest located in Vermont, situated in the Green Mountains. Established in 1932, the forest supports wildlife including beaver, moose, coyote, black bear, white-tailed deer, wild turkey, and ruffed grouse.
matters: It is a temperate broadleaf and mixed forest typical of the New England/Acadian forests ecoregion, and is one of only two national forest areas in New England.
